feed.title: Bullpen Phone: Washington Nationals reporter posts

entry.title: José Tena: The Guardians have claimed José Tena off waivers from the Nationals. Cleveland dealt him to Washington in the 2024 Lane Thomas trade.

Reiver Sanmartin: Nationals have acquired LHP Reiver Sanmartin from the Giants for RHP Robert Cranz. Sanmartin, 30, had 4.22 ERA, 1.359 WHIP in 24 games this season, was DFA'd earlier this week. Cranz, 7th round pick in '24, had strong year with Wilmington and Harrisburg, struggled at Rochester.

Jacob Young: The Nationals are signing CF Jacob Young to a contract extension, source confirms. According to Robert Murray of Fansided, it's 4 years and $23 million, which would buy out his arbitration years and first year of free agency (2030), plus an $8 million option for 2031.

Nate Furman: Parker and Tena are probably the most-notable moves here. Parker was going to arbitration-eligible after having TJ surgery in July. Tena was out of options and less defensive value than the just-acquired Nate Furman.

Tony Neubeck: The Nationals announce they've acquired 2B/3B Nat Furman from the Giants for minor-league LHP Tony Neubeck. Furman, 25, played in 22 MLB games this season, going 4-for-32. Lefty hitter slashed .292/.377/.414 at AAA. Has 2 more option years. LHP Richard Lovelady was DFA'd to clear a 40-man spot.
Braxton Roxby: First of many offseason transactions by the Nationals: They have claimed RHP Braxton Roxby off waivers from the Giants and DFAd RHP Zak Kent to clear a 40-man roster spot.
